result.instructions: Tools for Biteship, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which couriers can ship from Pesanggrahan to Pacet this week, and what does each one cost?"; "Track the shipment with tracking id 66eba364e2e5a642a092819a."; "Show the status of order 5dd599ebdefcd4158eb8470b.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Biteship data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run biteship_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run biteship_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run biteship_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. biteship_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: biteship_list_couriers
tools.title: List couriers
tools.description: List the courier services Biteship can book, with courier_code, courier_service_code, service type and cash-on-delivery and proof-of-delivery support. Good first call. Biteship API: GET /v1/couriers.

tools.name: biteship_search_areas
tools.title: Search areas
tools.description: Find Biteship area ids by place name, for example 'Pesanggrahan' or 'Jakarta Selatan'. Use the id in biteship_get_rates and biteship_create_order. Each call counts against the Maps quota on live keys. Biteship API: GET /v1/maps/areas.

countries.description: ISO country codes, comma separated (default ID, Indonesia).

tools.name: biteship_get_rates
tools.title: Get shipping rates
tools.description: Quote the price and delivery time of each courier service for one route. Returns quotes only; no order is created. Each quote has company and type values; biteship_create_order takes them as courier_company and courier_type. Each call counts against the Rates quota on live keys. Biteship API: POST /v1/rates/couriers.

couriers.description: Courier codes separated by commas, from biteship_list_couriers, for example 'jne,sicepat'.

value.description: Declared item value. Biteship prices in IDR.

tools.name: biteship_get_location
tools.title: Get a saved location
tools.description: Read one saved location (an address in the customer's Biteship address book) by its id. Biteship API: GET /v1/locations/{id}.

location_id.description: Location id from the Biteship dashboard.

tools.name: biteship_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Read one order by its id: status, courier, waybill_id, tracking_id and status history. Biteship API: GET /v1/orders/{id}.

order_id.description: Order id, from biteship_create_order or the Biteship dashboard.

tools.name: biteship_get_tracking
tools.title: Track a shipment
tools.description: Read the tracking status and history of a shipment by its tracking id (courier.tracking_id on the order). Biteship API: GET /v1/trackings/{id}.

tracking_id.description: Tracking id, from the order's courier.tracking_id.

tools.name: biteship_create_order
tools.title: Create a shipping order (spends balance)
tools.description: BOOKS A LIVE SHIPMENT: creates a Biteship order and asks the courier to pick up the parcel. It uses the customer's monthly Orders quota or Biteship balance. Call only when the user asks to book this exact shipment, after a rate check with biteship_get_rates. Set confirm_spend to true only after the user approves the cost. Undo with biteship_cancel_order. Biteship API: POST /v1/orders.

confirm_spend.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user approves that this order books a courier and spends balance.

origin_contact_name.description: Name of the person at the pickup location.

origin_contact_phone.description: Phone of the person at the pickup location.

origin_note.description: Pickup note, for example the building colour.

origin_latitude.description: Pickup latitude. Send with origin_longitude. Instant couriers need coordinates.

courier_company.description: Courier code from biteship_get_rates (company), for example 'jne'.

courier_type.description: Service type from biteship_get_rates (type), for example 'reg'.

delivery_type.description: 'now' asks for pickup at once. 'scheduled' also needs delivery_date and delivery_time.

delivery_date.description: Pickup date, yyyy-mm-dd. Required for scheduled orders.

delivery_time.description: Pickup time, HH:mm (24 hours). Required for scheduled orders.

reference_id.description: Your own order id, to match this order later.

value.description: Declared item value. Biteship prices in IDR.

tools.name: biteship_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel an order
tools.description: Cancel a live Biteship order by its id. Use only when the user asks to cancel that order. Reason codes in the docs: change_courier, pickup_delay, change_address, others. Biteship API: POST /v1/orders/{id}/cancel.

cancellation_reason_code.description: Reason code from the Biteship docs: change_courier, pickup_delay, change_address or others.

cancellation_reason.description: Free-text reason, for example when the code is 'others'.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Biteship
prompts.description: What you can do with Biteship here, with example requests to try.
